title: 대나무 숲의 협곡
scene: Dense bamboo canyon with a wide diagonal dirt road and two staggered clearings; bamboo palisade outpost toward lower right.

title: 계단식 논과 수차
scene: Terraced rice fields sweeping around a hillside, large working waterwheel and raised switchback lanes, granary near the upper left.

title: 도공 마을의 가마터
scene: Pottery village, giant climbing kilns on the left, ochre clay yards, winding broad roads around central ceramic sheds, protected gate near bottom right.

title: 폭포 아래의 나루
scene: A roaring waterfall feeds a horizontal river across the upper-middle field, two staggered timber bridges, ferry landing and road junction, fort in bottom left.

title: 암초 해안의 봉수대
scene: Rocky turquoise cove, zigzag shoreline lanes and two small piers, signal-fire watchtower on a promontory to upper left, sea on the right.

title: 차밭 언덕의 보급로
scene: Tea plantation hills, long curved dirt supply road between contour rows, broad flat staging terraces, roadside post upper right.

title: 석등 정원의 참배길
scene: Temple stone-lantern garden with koi ponds, rectangular gravel courtyard and asymmetric stone steps, shrine-gate at lower left.

title: 얼어붙은 호수 길
scene: A frozen shallow lake occupies central field, packed snow paths skirt both banks and cross a rough ice causeway, hut fort upper right.

title: 등불 축제의 골목
scene: Night festival town, wide L-shaped lanes lined with warm paper lanterns and unoccupied stalls, open square lower right, storehouse upper left.

title: 산성 외곽의 해자
scene: Mountain fortress outer dry moat and narrow ridge, offset drawbridge approaches from bottom and right, timber gate upper left.

title: 거목 계곡의 목교
scene: Ancient giant cedar ravine with a diagonal stream, a single high wooden bridge and two rugged terrace approaches, fort at lower center.

title: 삼각주 관개 제방
scene: River delta triangle rice parcels, irrigation canals with levee T-junctions, wide dry berms and raised sluice building at upper center.

title: 무사 저택의 담장길
scene: Samurai residential quarter, tall white plaster walls and roofed perimeter gates, offset broad lanes forming an S around gardens, gate at lower right.

title: 모래톱의 세 갈림길
scene: Wide shallow braided river with exposed sandbars and stepping causeways, two selectable broad crossings, river fort at far left middle.

title: 절벽 포구의 창고
scene: Steep sea cliffs around a small cove, lower-left piers and stair-cut terrace road to fortified warehouse on the right, broad dry rock shelves.

title: 바위 협곡의 역참
scene: Layered red-gray rock canyon, central horse-post relay courtyard and road hairpins threading left-bottom to right-top, supply depot near center-right.

title: 절벽 위의 오층탑
scene: A five-story pagoda on a cliff-top terrace, long diagonal staircase and two stone-courtyard access lanes, red autumn foliage at perimeter.

title: 폭설 속의 온천 마을
scene: Snow-covered hot-spring village, steaming pools and thatched inns at perimeter, two packed-snow street loops, protected gate at lower center.

title: 갈대 습지의 달빛
scene: Moonlit reed marsh, wooden causeways crossing black reflective pools, broad dry islands with torch posts, watch hut at upper right.

title: 성곽 이중 문루
scene: Double fortress gatehouses, offset dogleg courtyards and tall stone embankments, two broad enemy approaches ending at inner gate upper center.

title: 삼나무 절벽의 포위
scene: Cedar cliffs encircle a broad elevated ridge clearing, exposed root terraces, three asymmetric winding approach lanes converge on palisade gate at right-center.

title: 무너진 둑의 황금 들녘
scene: Golden mature rice plain with a visibly breached levee and flood channel, dry raised zigzag roads, grain stronghold lower left and levee post upper right.

title: 성하 수로와 돌다리
scene: Large castle-town canal quarter, blue-water channels with stone arched bridges, wide winding streets and separate plaza terraces, two defended storehouses.

title: 대하 합류점의 성채
scene: Two great rivers join into a Y-shaped waterway around a triangular fortress island, two widely separated timber crossing choices and broad banks.

title: 폭풍 앞의 해상 요새
scene: Coastal stone-and-timber island sea fort under approaching storm clouds, empty fortified piers and broad breakwater lanes, harbor storehouse at upper center.

title: 고산 절벽의 잔도
scene: High mountain sheer cliff road with ancient wooden gallery sections, broad safe switchback terraces and valley below, caravan camp at lower right.

title: 붉은 산문의 대사찰
scene: Grand vermilion temple gate and sprawling Buddhist compound, massive broad stone stair and three open courtyard routes, autumn mountains around the edge.

title: 설산 능선의 최후 관문
scene: A snowy high mountain ridge, three long packed-snow approaches and open staging plateaus around a narrow timber final gate, blue sunset on snow.

title: 안개 낀 대저택의 잠입로
scene: Fog-filled daimyo mansion grounds at night, moat gardens, broad winding lanes around large halls, torch-lit courtyards and perimeter entrances.

title: 천수각 삼중 방어선
scene: Large realistic Japanese castle keep at upper right, three concentric stone defensive courts with offset massive gates and spacious approaches, dramatic cloudy daylight.
